notes: Synthetic retrieval-evaluation corpus (ProjectA/ProjectB, zephyr/quokka/widget vocabulary only — never real project identifiers). Relevance is labelled by INTENT, independent of what the current scorer ranks. See README.md beside this file for the contract.

memories.name: Zephyr calibration
memories.description: Calibrating zephyr sensors on ProjectA widgets
memories.body:
**Why:** zephyr sensors drift after firmware flashing.

**How to apply:** run the calibration procedure after every flash; see [[projecta_widget_firmware]] for the flashing order. The vendor history lives in [[archive_zephyr_vendor_contract]].

memories.name: Zephyr calibration (legacy)
memories.description: Superseded zephyr calibration steps for the v1 widget
memories.body:
**Why:** the v1 widget used a manual calibration table.

**How to apply:** only when servicing a v1 widget; otherwise use [[projecta_zephyr_calibration]].

memories.name: Widget firmware flashing
memories.description: How ProjectA widget firmware is flashed and verified
memories.body:
**Why:** a half-flashed widget bricks silently.

**How to apply:** flash, verify the checksum, then recalibrate via [[projecta_zephyr_calibration]]. Hardware quirks: [[projecta_bootloader_notes]].

memories.name: Bootloader notes
memories.description: Bootloader quirks on widget hardware revision C
memories.body:
**Why:** revision C ignores the reset pin during a flash.

**How to apply:** power-cycle before flashing; then continue with the normal flashing order.

memories.name: Widget sensor matrix
memories.description: Sensor matrix layout for ProjectA widgets
memories.body:
**Why:** the sensor matrix decides which channels exist.

**How to apply:** consult the matrix before wiring a new sensor channel.

memories.name: Lantern telemetry
memories.description: Hourly polling rules for lantern telemetry
memories.body:
**Why:** lantern telemetry cadence is hourly, not per event.

**How to apply:** never poll lantern faster than the hourly cadence. Supplier questions: [[reference_sensor_vendor_faq]].

memories.name: Zephyr vendor contract
memories.description: Archived vendor contract for zephyr sensor supply
memories.body:
**Why:** historical supply terms for zephyr sensors.

**How to apply:** nothing operational; kept for the audit trail. Calibration itself is [[projecta_zephyr_calibration]].

memories.name: Quokka deploy pipeline
memories.description: ProjectB quokka service deploy pipeline and rollback
memories.body:
**Why:** quokka deploys go through staging first.

**How to apply:** deploy to staging, watch the metrics, then promote; a failed rollback is documented in [[projectb_quokka_rollback_incident]]. Promotion is paused during the weeks in [[projectb_freeze_calendar]].

memories.name: Quokka rollback incident
memories.description: Rollback failed after a quokka deploy in staging
memories.body:
**Why:** the rollback step assumed the previous image still existed.

**How to apply:** pin the previous image before a deploy; pipeline is [[projectb_quokka_deploy]].

memories.name: Quokka metrics dashboard
memories.body:
**Why:** latency regressions show up here first.

**How to apply:** check the dashboard after every quokka deploy.

memories.name: Mailbox retention
memories.description: Retention window for ProjectB shared mailboxes
memories.body:
**Why:** shared mailboxes fill up within a week.

**How to apply:** the purgewindow and quotaflag settings control it; keep the window at seven days.

memories.name: Redis TLS handshake
memories.description: TLS handshake fix for Redis 7 clients
memories.body:
**Why:** Redis 7 rejects the legacy cipher list.

**How to apply:** set the client cipher list explicitly before the TLS handshake.

memories.name: Postgres vacuum tuning
memories.description: Autovacuum thresholds for large ProjectB tables
memories.body:
**Why:** the default autovacuum thresholds never trigger on large tables.

**How to apply:** lower the scale factor per table.

memories.name: Widget glossary
memories.description: Terms used across ProjectA widget docs
memories.body:
**Why:** newcomers confuse zephyr, quokka, widget, firmware, and calibration.

**How to apply:** zephyr is the sensor family, quokka is the ProjectB service, widget is the ProjectA device, firmware is what gets flashed, calibration is what follows a flash.

memories.name: Terse commit messages
memories.body:
**Why:** long commit messages hide the change.

**How to apply:** one imperative line, no trailer blocks.

memories.name: User prefers bash
memories.description: Ship helper scripts as bash, python only for parsing
memories.body:
**Why:** the fleet runs without a managed python environment.

**How to apply:** bash entrypoints; python heredocs only where parsing needs it.

memories.name: Freeze calendar
memories.description: Weeks when ProjectB promotions are frozen
memories.body:
**Why:** month-end weeks are frozen for every ProjectB service.

**How to apply:** no promotions during a listed freeze week; wait for the window to reopen.

memories.name: Sensor vendor FAQ
memories.description: Questions the sensor supplier has answered
memories.body:
**Why:** the supplier answers the same lead-time and packaging questions repeatedly.

**How to apply:** check here before emailing the supplier.

cases.prompt: what does projecta_zephyr_calibration say about drift
cases.rationale: Exact slug lookup; the stale legacy entry and the archived contract are not the current procedure.

cases.prompt: how do I run the zephyr calibration on the widget
cases.rationale: Only the current procedure answers the intent. The stale legacy steps and the glossary (which merely defines both words) do not.

cases.prompt: flash the widget firmware and verify it
cases.rationale: Single tag term; the glossary and calibration entries mention firmware only in prose.

cases.prompt: tell me everything we know about quokka
cases.rationale: Broad intent: all three quokka entries are relevant; the glossary is not.

cases.prompt: how does a quokka rollback work and when did it fail
cases.rationale: Both the incident and the pipeline answer the intent; metrics does not.

cases.prompt: what is the lantern telemetry cadence
cases.rationale: Search: body-only term (weight 1). Hook: lantern/telemetry carry it.

cases.prompt: lanternfeed polling rules
cases.rationale: Term present only in tags (weight 5): never in slug, name, description, or body.

cases.prompt: the redis tls handshake keeps failing
cases.rationale: Phrase atom (search/recall); the hook extractor sees separate terms.

cases.prompt: autovacuum thresholds for postgres tables
cases.rationale: Prefix atom vacu* matches the 'vacuum' token in the slug, name, and tags; 'autovacuum' is a separate token that it does not match.

cases.prompt: zephyr nonexistentterm
cases.rationale: The intent is zephyr; only the current calibration entry answers it. The full query has zero hits, so search/recall reach it through the degraded fallback; the hook queries per term and never degrades.

cases.prompt: legacy zephyr calibration for the v1 widget
cases.rationale: Intent explicitly asks for the legacy steps; the stale entry is the right answer despite halving.

cases.prompt: configure the kubernetes ingress controller
cases.rationale: Nothing in the store is about kubernetes; every mode must return nothing.

cases.prompt: when is the orchestra symphony rehearsal tonight
cases.rationale: Three-atom query with zero overlap; degraded fallback must not manufacture a hit.

cases.prompt: which sensor channels does the widget expose
cases.rationale: Four entries carry the widget tag; only the sensor matrix answers the intent.

cases.prompt: firmware flashing order
cases.rationale: Bootloader notes answer the quirks half of the intent. They match only 'flashing' in the body, below the hook's direct-seed threshold, but are linked from the firmware entry, so graph-on is the only way the hook can reach them.

cases.prompt: calibration procedure after a flash
cases.rationale: Only the current calibration entry answers the intent. The seed links to an archived vendor contract and the firmware entry, which do not; with graph-on they can only add non-relevant rows (fixed-denominator P@5 may be unchanged while returned_precision falls).

cases.prompt: should helper scripts be bash or python
cases.rationale: Standing user preference; 'scripts' also appears only in the tags of this entry.

cases.prompt: how should I phrase commit messages
cases.rationale: Feedback entry; 'messages' appears only in name/description.

cases.prompt: what is the retention window we use for the shared mailbox
cases.rationale: Prompt is mostly stop words and short tokens; retention/mailbox/shared/window must survive extraction.

cases.prompt: reference notes on redis
cases.rationale: The type field (weight 3) plus a tag; other reference entries lack redis.

cases.prompt: is there a glossary of widget terms
cases.rationale: Single-tag hit on an entry whose body would otherwise match many vocabularies.

cases.prompt: the staging rollback incident details
cases.rationale: Three atoms all present on one entry; the deploy pipeline carries only two.

cases.prompt: please help me with this thing
cases.rationale: Nothing in the store matches. The hook extractor drops 'please'/'help'/'with'/'this' as stop words and keeps 'thing', which matches no entry; search must return nothing.

cases.prompt: purgewindow quotaflag settings
cases.rationale: Two body-only terms; the hook's two-distinct-terms rule should qualify the seed where one term alone would not.

cases.prompt: redis-tls handshake cipher list
cases.rationale: Hyphenated extractor token splits into two scorer atoms; provenance may list both.

cases.prompt: how does the quokka pipeline promote a build
cases.rationale: Coverage construction: the freeze calendar answers when promotion is allowed, shares no query/prompt token with the case, and is reachable only through the [[projectb_freeze_calendar]] link in the deploy entry. Any mode without graph expansion cannot return it.

cases.prompt: lantern telemetry cadence
cases.rationale: Coverage construction: the sensor vendor FAQ is linked from the lantern entry but shares no query/prompt token with the case and does not answer the intent. Only graph expansion can add it, so any extra row here is a pure precision loss.

cases.prompt: who approves a quokka deploy before promotion
cases.rationale: The store knows the quokka pipeline but records nothing about approvers, so nothing answers the intent. The strong lexical overlap makes every mode likely to return quokka rows; those are false positives by construction.
